arguments.script: var folder="Assets/Tiles/UnifiedTerrain";var method=typeof(UnityEditor.Tilemaps.GridPaletteUtility).GetMethods(System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic).Single(m=>m.Name=="CreateGridPalette"&&m.GetParameters().Length==1);foreach(var path in System.IO.Directory.GetFiles(folder,"* Palette.prefab")){var type=method.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType;var settings=(UnityEngine.ScriptableObject)method.Invoke(null,new object[]{System.Enum.Parse(type,"Manual")});UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AddObjectToAsset(settings,path);}UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();return "Six registered manual-size Tile Palettes";
arguments.summary: Register six native-size Tile Palettes for painting terrain
